title: Choose the MX Bikes menu composition
question: Your current main menu (rider, #77 bike, grey studio) stays the stage. Holeshot F8 chrome restyles the dests only — no Holeshot mark or HUD wordmark.

options.label: Top hardware bar
options.thesis: A thin charcoal-side bar owns destinations. The in-game rider and bike own the rest of the screen.
options.viewport: Same 3D stage as now: grey studio, dirt floor, blue #77 bike on a stand, rider in white kit standing beside it. Destinations move into a 56px charcoal-side top bar. Single Player is the orange skew plaque. No Holeshot mark.
options.risk: Can read as a website chrome strip instead of a game menu.

raised.raise: One horizontal chrome band is the only committed layer; the rider is everything else.
Garage, options, pit, and replay reuse this same bar, not a new layout per screen.

options.label: Left rail over track
options.thesis: Stock MX Bikes topology: a night-ink left plaque of destinations, rider and bike filling the open stage.
options.viewport: Keep today's layout. Left night-ink F8 rail: Single Player, Multi Player, My Bike, My Profiles, My Replays, My Best Laps, Settings, Exit. Orange pip on Single Player. Quiet MX BIKES in ExtraBold Italic, not a Holeshot mark. Rider and #77 bike stay exactly where they are.
options.risk: Reads as a recolor of the stock PiBoSo menu.

options.label: Split booth
options.thesis: Destinations left, last-session as a thin lower-third, rider stays center-stage.
options.viewport: Today's rider and #77 bike stay center-right. Left F8 rail of the same dests. Thin LAST SESSION orange skew strip under the dirt, never covering boots.
options.risk: The lower-third can still clip boots if it sits too high.
